# Feinberg School of Medicine News Center

> Northwestern Feinberg School of Medicine's news hub covering groundbreaking research, clinical advances, faculty achievements, and medical education initiatives.

The Feinberg School of Medicine News Center publishes stories about faculty research, student accomplishments, clinical breakthroughs, and institutional milestones. Coverage spans biomedical research funded by the NIH, clinical trials, medical education programs, and healthcare leadership in the Chicago area.

## Key Topics

- Feinberg School of Medicine
- Northwestern University
- Medical research
- Clinical trials
- NIH funding
- Medical education
- End-of-life care
- Palliative medicine
- Healthcare innovation
- Faculty research
- Student achievements
- Chicago healthcare
- Biomedical discovery
- Medical rankings

## Research & Clinical Breakthroughs

- [Lupus Discovery May Lead To Improved Drugs](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2004/03/01/lupus_discovery): Feinberg researchers discover lupus drug development pathway
- [Researchers Link Brain Region to Fly Slumber](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2006/06/01/fly): Ravi Allada's research on sleep mechanisms in fruit flies
- [Drug Treats 'Water Intoxication' Faster, More Effectively](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2006/11/01/water): Tolvaptan clinical trials show improved hyponatremia treatment
- [System Helps Curb Severe Anemia](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2004/10/01/anemia): Northwestern research on epoetin safety in anemia treatment
- [Crohn's Disease Therapies Tested](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2002/08/01/crohns_disease): Feinberg clinical trials for inflammatory bowel disease treatment
- [Hyperglycemia and Pregnancy Study Receives $9.2 Million](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2004/07/01/hyperglycemia): NIH-funded HAPO study on gestational diabetes outcomes

## Research Funding & Institutional Recognition

- [Five Departments Make NIH Top 20 List](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2003/06/01/nih_list): Feinberg departments rank in top 20 NIH research funding
- [Medical School Moves Up in U.S. News Rankings](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2004/04/01/rankings-2): Feinberg School advances in U.S. News medical school rankings

## Faculty Leadership & Healthcare Innovation

- [Martha Twaddle Passionate About End-of-Life Care](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2006/02/01/twaddle): Profile of Martha Twaddle's work in hospice and end-of-life care
- [Let Patients Describe Race/Ethnicity](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2006/03/01/race): Study on patient self-identification in healthcare data collection
- [Sleep Loss Affects High Schoolers](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2005/06/01/sleep_loss): Northwestern study on adolescent sleep deprivation and performance
- [The 1995 Heat Wave: Autopsy of Disaster](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2002/07/01/heat_wave): Eric Klinenberg's analysis of Chicago's 1995 heat wave impact

## Medical Education & Student Programs

- [Schweitzer Fellows Help the Underserved](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2003/05/01/schweitzer_fellows): Northwestern Schweitzer Fellows program serves underserved communities
- [Summer Program Helps Aspiring Physicians](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2005/08/01/smep): Feinberg's Summer Medical Education Program for premed students
- [Accepted Students Take a Second Look](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2006/04/01/look): Feinberg School hosts admitted students weekend event
- [Founders' Day Convocation to Welcome New Medical Students](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2002/08/01/founders_day): Feinberg School welcomes Class of 2006 at Founders' Day

## Digital Innovation & Historical Projects

- [16th Century Meets the 21st on Vesalius Web Site](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2003/04/01/16th_century): Northwestern's digital Vesalius anatomy text project
